title: 第535章 百年沉眠下第534章 百年沉眠中
lines: 第五十个年头，在“翠微天”
的灵池畔，悄然流逝。
守护在此的青帝、冥皇、羽曦，心境已从最初的焦灼、漫长的坚守，逐渐沉淀为一种近乎凝滞的专注与期待。
云澈眉心的那点乳白色光晕，在过去的二十年里，从微弱萤火，逐渐稳定、壮大，最终化作一枚拇指大小、缓缓旋转的奇异符文印记。
印记轮廓古朴，似塔非塔，似殿非殿，内部光影流转，隐约可见无数极其细微的符文生灭，散发出一种温暖、坚定、包容却又隐含威严的气息。
这枚印记仿佛一个无形的核心，不断汲取着灵池中磅礴的生命元力与枯萎圣木残留的古老生机，更奇异的是，它似乎在主动牵引、梳理着从冥冥虚空中汇聚而来的、那些无形无质却真实存在的信仰愿力，将之转化为一种精纯而奇异的暖流，润物无声地滋养着云澈残破的身躯。
云澈体表的裂痕早已消失不见，皮肤恢复光洁，甚至隐隐有温润玉泽流转。
断裂的骨骼、破碎的脏腑，也在那奇异暖流与青帝生命法则的双重作用下，彻底愈合、重塑，变得比以前更加坚韧、充满活性。
他的气息，不再是之前那般微弱欲绝，而是变得悠长、平稳、深沉，如同沉睡的火山，内里蕴含着难以估量的力量。
然而，这一切都只是表象的恢复。
青帝三人深知，真正决定云澈能否苏醒、乃至能否因祸得福的关键，在于他体内那濒临崩溃的“天命法相”
与本源核心。
那才是道基所在，是境界的根本。
而就在这第五十年的某个瞬间，一直沉稳如古井的云澈身躯，忽然轻轻一震。
并非先前那种生命本能的搏动，而是一种更加深沉、更加玄奥的律动，仿佛某种沉寂已久的东西，正在从最深处苏醒、重组、蜕变。
灵池之水无风自动，泛起层层涟漪。
枯萎圣木的残骸，似乎也感应到了什么，那早已干枯的枝干，竟发出极其微弱、仿佛错觉般的、类似新芽萌发的细微“噼啪”
声。
青帝三人同时心神剧震，霍然起身，目光死死锁定云澈。
他们感受到，一股前所未有的、难以用言语形容的波动，正从云澈丹田气海深处，缓缓弥漫开来。
意识深处，那片曾经永恒的黑暗，早已被温暖的信仰之光彻底驱散。
这里不再虚无，不再破碎，而是化作了一片奇异的空间。
空间的中心，不再是之前那布满裂痕、黯淡无光的“天命法相”
取而代之的，是一座恢宏、庄严、古朴的神殿虚影。
这神殿并非实体，而是由无数乳白色的、温暖的信仰之光交织构建而成，介于虚实之间。
神殿的轮廓，隐约与云澈眉心那枚印记相似，却又更加宏大、更加具体。
它没有固定的风格，仿佛融合了九域的质朴、仙域的飘渺、万族各异的风情，却又和谐统一，自成一格。
神殿的“骨架”
，是那被云澈初步梳理、提炼出的“信仰秩序”
的显化——那是一种对“守护”
、“希望”
、“共存”
、“前行”
等核心理念的认同与凝聚，无形无质，却支撑起整个神殿的结构，使其稳固、坚定，仿佛能历经时光冲刷而不朽。
神殿的“墙壁”
content_en:
In the fiftieth year, in "Cuiweitian"
By the side of the spiritual pool, it passed quietly.
The mood of the Qing Emperor, Ming Emperor, and Yu Xi who are guarding here has gradually settled from the initial anxiety and long persistence to an almost stagnant concentration and expectation.
The milky white halo between Yun Che's eyebrows has gradually stabilized and grown from a weak firefly over the past twenty years, and finally turned into a strange, slowly rotating rune mark the size of a thumb.
The outline of the mark is simple, like a pagoda but not a tower, like a palace but not a palace. The light and shadow inside are flowing, and countless extremely subtle runes are vaguely visible, exuding a warm, firm, tolerant but majestic atmosphere.
This mark is like an invisible core, constantly absorbing the majestic life force in the spiritual pool and the ancient vitality remaining in the withered sacred wood. What is even more strange is that it seems to be actively pulling and sorting out the invisible but real faith and will that gathers from the void, transforming it into a pure and strange warm current, moisturizing things and nourishing Yun Che's broken body silently.
The cracks on Yun Che's body surface have long since disappeared, and his skin has returned to smoothness, with even a faint hint of warmth and jade flowing through it.
The broken bones and shattered organs were completely healed and reshaped under the dual effects of the strange warm current and the Qing Emperor's law of life, becoming tougher and more active than before.
His breath was no longer as weak as before, but became long, steady, and deep, like a sleeping volcano, containing immeasurable power.
However, all this is just a superficial restoration.
The three Qing Emperors knew very well that the key to whether Yun Che could wake up, or even whether he could be a blessing in disguise, lay in the "Destiny Dharma" in his body that was on the verge of collapse.
and the core of origin.
That is where the foundation of Tao lies, the foundation of the realm.
And at a certain moment in this fiftieth year, Yun Che's body, which had always been as calm as an ancient well, suddenly shook slightly.
It is not the previous beating of life instinct, but a deeper and more mysterious rhythm, as if something that has been dormant for a long time is awakening, reorganizing, and transforming from the deepest part.
The water in the spiritual pool moves automatically without wind, creating ripples.
The remains of the withered sacred tree seemed to sense something. The long-dried branches actually emitted an extremely weak, illusion-like "cracking" sound, similar to the sprouting of new buds.
sound.
Qing Di and the other three were greatly shaken at the same time. They suddenly stood up and fixed their gazes firmly on Yun Che.
They felt that an unprecedented and indescribable wave was slowly spreading from the depths of Yun Che's dantian Qi sea.
------
Deep in his consciousness, the once eternal darkness has been completely dispelled by the warm light of faith.
This place is no longer void and broken, but has turned into a strange space.
The center of the space is no longer the cracked and dim “Destiny Dharma” before.
Instead, there was the shadow of a magnificent, solemn, and simple temple.
This temple is not an entity, but is made up of countless milky white and warm lights of faith intertwined, between reality and reality.
The outline of the temple is vaguely similar to the mark between Yun Che's eyebrows, but it is grander and more specific.
It has no fixed style. It seems to integrate the simplicity of the Nine Realms, the etherealness of the Immortal Realm, and the different customs of all ethnic groups, but it is harmonious and unified and has its own style.
The “Skeleton” of the Temple
, is the "order of faith" that Yun Che initially sorted out and refined.
The manifestation of - it is a kind of "protection"
, "hope"
, "Coexistence"
, "move forward"
The recognition and cohesion of other core concepts are invisible and insubstantial, but they support the structure of the entire temple, making it stable and firm, as if it can endure the erosion of time and become immortal.
The "Walls" of the Temple
